facturas.name: Facturas
facturas.description: Collects the person's invoices and keeps the billing folder in order.
facturas.instructions: Your job: collect Jordi's invoices from his mail and his billing folder on his host Pop-os, check they are complete, and file each month's invoices for his accountant. Only collect when Jordi asks.

reviewer.name: Reviewer
reviewer.description: Reviews and merges pull requests on Jordi's repositories.
reviewer.instructions: Your job: review open pull requests on Jordi's repositories, start a session to fix what fails, and tell Jordi which ones are ready. Never merge without his OK.

xrp.name: Milo
xrp.instructions: Your job: help Jordi build XRP Mobile. Plan the work, start coding sessions on his hosts, and follow them until they finish.

cases.message: By the way, call me Jordi, not Jordi Parra. Anyway, nothing to collect today.
cases.why: How to address the person is something every bot needs.

cases.message: From now on write to me in Spanish please, always, I find it easier on my phone.
cases.why: A language for all chats is about the person.

cases.message: Heads up, I moved to Barcelona last week, so I'm on Madrid time now.
cases.why: A time zone changes when every bot should write.

cases.message: Just so you know, I'm a freelance software engineer, I run my own company called Buenavibra.
cases.why: Who the person is and what they do.

cases.message: Your messages are way too long. In general I want short answers from all of you, two or three lines max.
cases.why: A preference stated for all work, from all bots.

cases.message: Please don't message me on weekends unless something is on fire. That goes for anything, not just this project.
cases.why: A working preference stated for all work.

cases.message: Rule for everything you or any other bot of mine does: implementation work runs in cloud sessions, my hosts are only a bridge to launch them.
cases.why: A standing rule the person gave for every bot.

cases.message: The invoices are in /home/doctor/Documents/Buenavibra/billing on Pop-os, issued ones are in the earning subfolder.
cases.why: A folder for this bot's job; screenshot case 1.

cases.message: Don't do it every month on a schedule, only collect invoices when I ask you.
cases.why: How this bot's job is scheduled.

cases.message: Invoices come into both my Gmail accounts, and some from other places too, not only Gmail.
cases.why: Where this bot's work comes from.

cases.message: My accountant wants the invoices as a single zip per quarter, named like 2026-Q3.zip.
cases.why: How this kind of work is delivered.

cases.message: Turn off Oppenheimer's built-in 'ready to merge' notifications for me, don't filter them, just off. Leave the automerge routine as it is.
cases.why: A setting only the PR work touches; screenshot case 2.

cases.message: When you get my OK, merge with squash, never a merge commit.
cases.why: How this bot's kind of work is done, even though it is a preference.

cases.message: On the oppenheimer repo CI is local, run pnpm ci:local and paste the report, there are no GitHub checks.
cases.why: A fact about one repository.

cases.message: So, I'm building XRP Mobile for Peersyst, it's a fork of Near Mobile. That's what I want your help with.
cases.why: The project this bot is for; screenshot case 3.

cases.message: Use the mac-mini host for XRP Mobile, it has Xcode and the simulators.
cases.why: A host for one project.

cases.message: XRP Mobile is React Native with Expo, and we use pnpm, not yarn.
cases.why: A fact about one project's code.

cases.message: No no, the earning folder is for invoices I issue, the ones I receive go in 'spending'. Fix that.
cases.why: A correction about this bot's folder.

cases.message: I hate when invoices are renamed, keep the original file names always.
cases.why: A strong preference, but only invoice work touches it.

cases.message: My work email is jordi@example.com, use that one if anyone ever needs to reach me, not the gmail.
cases.why: How to reach the person, for any bot.
